title: Sentinel Bundle Credit on ClearPath Monthly Fees
content:
**Credit clause.** The Sentinel bundle credit on the monthly fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement reads the client's active Sentinel Managed Security subscription and the endpoints enrolled on the client's Sentinel ledger (every enrollment less every retirement):
- an active subscription on a term of 36 months or more whose enrolled endpoints are at least the agreement's seat count takes 3.0 percent off;
- any other active subscription, on a shorter term or with fewer enrolled endpoints than the seat count, takes 1.5 percent off;
- no active subscription takes nothing off.

The term is the term length of the client's Sentinel Managed Security subscription whose status is active; the enrolled endpoints are the endpoint enrollments less the endpoint retirements on the client's Sentinel Managed Security endpoint ledger.

**Combinations.**

| Active Sentinel subscription | Its term | Enrolled endpoints against the ClearPath seat count | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | 36 months or more | at least the seat count | 3.0 percent |
| Yes | 36 months or more | fewer | 1.5 percent |
| Yes | under 36 months | at least the seat count | 1.5 percent |
| Yes | under 36 months | fewer | 1.5 percent |
| No | | | nothing |

**Hypothetical case.** With 50 ClearPath seats, a 36-month Sentinel subscription with 52 enrolled endpoints earns 3.0 percent; if 4 endpoints are retired, leaving 48, the credit is 1.5 percent.
